THIS IS SAFE WHILE THE TOKEN IS TRANSFER-LOCKED A vibe/vibe token reverts `TransfersLocked()` (0xdb89e3f4) on transfer and transferFrom for the whole curve phase, so this contract never custodies the game token before graduation. Stakes are denominated in the game token (via `curve.spotPriceWad()`) but collected in ETH. The token is the unit of account; ETH is the rail. That keeps the game fully playable from block one. On `CurveCompleted` the game arms custody, and `assetForWager()` flips from ETH to the game token. Every entry and exit path routes through that single function, so arming requires no migration of existing state \u2014 new wagers simply settle in the token.PRICE SOURCE Prices come from `IVibeCurve(curve).spotPriceWad()`, verified live on-chain. assetForWager().details: address(0) means native ETH (curve phase). After graduation this      returns the game token. Every entry and exit path calls this, so      arming custody needs no state migration.

custodyAvailable().details: Reads the CURVE, not the token: the token exposes no graduated()      view at all (verified — it reverts with empty data).

enter().details: Open-join: everyone who enters before closeBlock gets the same      entry price, so the race is decided purely by the curve.      The closeBlock check is load-bearing. Without it, a player could      enter after the round's deadline and still be settled at the      original entry price, effectively time-travelling into a round      that had already resolved.

onCurveCompleted(uint256,uint256).details: Verified topic0: 0x654e1d49372e305713e05ff2ed090670dd8683b365ce33618c15e187b875d21d      Signature: CurveCompleted(uint256 netRaisedWei, uint256 completedAt)

roundState(uint64).details: `Round` cannot be returned directly because it contains a mapping,      so the UI reads round state through this. Field order matches      Round: id, openBlock, closeBlock, phase, totalStake, pot, rake,      entryPriceWad, voided.

settle().details: Permissionless. Under 2 entrants the round is voided and every      entrant refunds. Ties split the pot evenly.

MIN_ENTRANTS().notice: A round needs at least this many entrants to be settleable.

RAKE_BPS().notice: Protocol rake on the pot, in basis points (2.5%).

ROUND_BLOCKS().notice: Round length in blocks. ~100ms blocks on Robinhood Chain Testnet         => 300 blocks ~= 30 seconds.

approveGameToken(uint256).notice: Approve the game contract to pull your game token (post-graduation).

assetForWager().notice: The asset wagers are collected in.

bestPnlWad().notice: Highest PnL ever recorded, for the leaderboard.

claimRefund(uint64).notice: Claim a refund from a voided round you were in.

curve().notice: The bonding curve whose movement the game prices.

custodyArmed().notice: True once the curve graduated and token custody is armed.

custodyAvailable().notice: True when the token can actually be held by this contract.

enter().notice: Stake ETH and join the open round.

enterWithToken(uint256).notice: Enter with game token instead of ETH. Only valid after graduation.

gameToken().notice: The game's own launched token, minted on vibe/vibe.

leaderboard().notice: Live leaderboard head: best positive PnL and who achieved it.

onCurveCompleted(uint256,uint256).notice: Arms token custody when the curve completes.

pnlWad(uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Signed PnL in wei for a given stake at the given prices.         Public so the UI and tests can reproduce the exact same number         the contract settled on.

roundState(uint64).notice: Round state as a flat tuple.

secondsRemaining().notice: Seconds remaining in the current round, for the UI countdown.

settle().notice: Close the round, pay the winner, and open the next one.

withdrawRake().notice: Withdraw accumulated rake to the treasury.
